title: Sandia DOE Reference Model Project
reviewed_sections: RM1 linked resource, performance and experimental documents
supported_claims: The programme identifies reference geometry, resource, experimental and cost-model materials for RM1 and other reference models.
limitations: Some download bundles require submitting a form; no source measurements were downloaded.

title: DOE RM1: Experimental Results — Hill et al.
supported_claims: The report documents RM1 experimental methodology and reported combined power-coefficient measurement uncertainty of approximately 3.9%.
limitations: Only selected pages reviewed; raw time-series not acquired; no Cp curve reproduced.

title: RealTide Deliverable 1.1 FMEA report
supported_claims: Four generic concept decompositions examined; electrical, rotor and drivetrain systems are important criticality priorities.
FMEA component/mode counts differ by concept complexity and do not measure actual failure probabilities.
limitations: Report is 198 pages, not fully reviewed; ordinal/constructed risk assessments cannot establish measured service life.

title: Orbital Marine technology page
supported_claims: Orbital describes a floating/retractable-leg service-access concept.
limitations: Claims of service cost advantage are developer promotional statements, not independently verified comparisons.

title: D2T2 Accelerator — Nova Innovation project periodic reporting
reviewed_sections: project information and 2019-2020 periodic report summary
supported_claims: Nova reported direct-drive M100-D development and lower cost targets.
limitations: Statements in EC-hosted partner reporting must not be treated as independent comparative LCOE, availability, or failure-rate evidence.

title: Gambuzza et al., Model-scale experiments of passive pitch control
supported_claims: One passively pitching blade on a 1.2m model-scale turbine reduced root-bending-moment fluctuation by 15–45% over investigated tip-speed ratios, per the paper.
Spring and bearing friction and preload could erode benefits and increase mean loading.
limitations: Not a full-scale endurance, MTBF or lifetime-cost experiment; inflow conditions and uncertainties must be replayed before generalization.

title: Minesto Deep Green technology
supported_claims: Developer describes tethered cross-current kite technology and reported electricity-to-grid milestones.
limitations: Reported recovery and performance figures require independent test/design review.

title: HydroQuest tidal turbines and services
supported_claims: Developer offers engineering, turbine supply, installation, maintenance and monitoring.
limitations: This page does not independently quantify cross-flow rotor fatigue or performance.

title: MeyGen original developer page (redirected)
supported_claims: As accessed 2026-10-20, original deep link redirected to Ampeak corporate landing page.
limitations: Original URL does not supply directly usable current metrics; do not quote stale embedded widget values.

title: Ampeak MeyGen offshore servicing release
reviewed_sections: public company news release and summary
supported_claims: Ampeak reported inspection, servicing and redeployment of three turbines in December 2025, with one returned to shore.
limitations: Corporate operations claim; maintenance event counts cannot be used as unbiased population failure rates.

title: Government of Nova Scotia tidal energy overview
supported_claims: Province describes licensed projects, FORCE activity, regional tidal potential and applicable marine renewable policy.
limitations: Regional resource estimates and development plans do not validate a particular site or machine.

title: Fundy Ocean Research Centre for Energy home
supported_claims: FORCE identifies Bay of Fundy tidal-stream research infrastructure and monitoring work.
limitations: Homepage live sensor placeholders do not provide a reusable measured ADCP series.

title: DFO Guide to environmental monitoring for tidal devices, Bay of Fundy
supported_claims: DFO requires risk-based, adaptive monitoring within staged federal authorization; variability must cover tide, diel and seasons.
limitations: Guidance is not a site permit; device-specific species interaction probability remains unmeasured in this repository.

title: OES Environmental 2024 State of the Science
reviewed_sections: report bibliographic metadata and topic index
supported_claims: 2024 synthesis covers collision, sound, EMF, habitat, wildlife, and human dimensions.
limitations: 313-page report not read: no detailed chapter conclusions or quantitative ecological claims adopted.
access_status: metadata/abstract only; full 43MB report not downloaded

title: DNV-ST-0164 Tidal turbines
supported_claims: Public DNV site states edition October 2015, amended November 2021, for tidal turbines across their lifecycle.
limitations: Full normative text behind subscription; edition current only as shown on accessible page; no compliance assessment possible.
access_status: summary public; full text subscription gated

title: QBlade Marine Hydrokinetic documentation 2.0.9.7
supported_claims: Docs describe marine-hydrokinetic setup and added-mass/buoyancy considerations.
limitations: No independent validation for the proposed turbine; using a manual does not confer appropriate licence or model suitability.

title: QBlade official licensing FAQ
supported_claims: QBlade says APL permits non-commercial use; commercial use requires licensing.
limitations: Full license wording, version, reproducibility and alternatives must be independently checked.

title: Nova Scotia Tidal Demonstration Permit
supported_claims: Province lists 7.70MW program cap, project under 2MW, closing applications October 30, 2026.
limitations: Application conditions subject to regulator decisions and updates; this repo has no permit.

title: Province announces new Eauclaire tidal projects
supported_claims: New FORCE berths awarded for Eauclaire/Orbital projects were announced.
limitations: Announcement alone is not evidence machines deployed or generated electricity.

title: FORCE 2025 project update
reviewed_sections: project update paragraphs on Eauclaire and DFO authorization
supported_claims: FORCE reports DFO authorization for deployment of up to three Orbital O2-X turbines.
limitations: Authorization is not proof of deployment; attached annual-report PDF not fully reviewed.

title: Confederacy of Mainland Mi’kmaq — Bay of Fundy Ecological Knowledge Study
supported_claims: Confederacy of Mainland Mi’kmaq led an ecological knowledge study to inform Bay of Fundy planning and monitoring.
limitations: Full 103-page report not downloaded; this does not grant project permission or replace engagement/Indigenous rights considerations.
access_status: study link public; conflicting reporting dates recorded
